description: This Java class 'Format' provides utility methods for formatting dates, percentages, and other data types according to locale and format type. It includes methods for formatting dates in different styles (date, time, timestamp), formatting percentages, and converting exceptions to string with stack trace.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for formatting dates, numbers, percentages, and exceptions based on locale and format type.

methods.name: formatPercentage(double pct)
methods.description: Formats a double percentage value as a locale-specific percent string.

methods.name: formatPercentage(Number pct)
methods.description: Formats a Number object as a locale-specific percent string, returns empty string if null.

methods.name: format(Double d)
methods.description: Converts a Double to string, returns empty if null.

methods.description: Formats a date for display in a text box, using default locale and date format.
